g.text: Comprehensive End-to-End Enterprise System Topology, Multi-Tier Component Interaction & Real-Time Data Flow
Modern Web Browser Environment & Progressive Web Application (PWA)
Dual Tab (Login / Register) · Hero Brand Logo · Token Extraction · Session Bootstrapping
1-on-1 Direct Contacts · Collapsible Root Groups & Nested Subgroups
Workspace Channels Folders · Online Badges · Unread Counts · Instant Filter Search
Virtualized Message Bubbles · Multi-Recipient Typing Indicator · Read Status Ticks (✓✓)
Emoji Picker · Media File Ingestion · Forward & Delete Actions · Call Header Triggers
Nested Subgroup Creator (+Add Subgroup) · Parent Navigation Banner
Workspace Invite Code Generator · Admin Role Verification · Member Removal
RTCPeerConnection Lifecycle · Local / Remote MediaStream Elements
Mic Mute · Camera Toggle · Screen Sharing Track Swap · Call Duration Timer
Profile Card Editor · Avatar Upload / Remove · Status Presets · Password Change
Muted Chats & Blocked Users List · Full-Screen Lightbox Image Zoom
Workspace Creation · 6-Character Join Code Exchange · Channel Category Categorizer
Browser Platform Drivers: Web Notifications & Web Audio
notificationService.js: Native Notification API · Service Worker Background Push · Vibrate & Heads-up Banners
zyntraSound.js: Web Audio API Oscillator synthesizer for incoming message chime, ringtones & call teardown
themeStore.js: Persistent user visual mode (Light / Dark) & sound toggles via browser localStorage
• Maps userId & username to Set of socket IDs
• Caller creates SDP Offer with audio & video tracks
• Callee receives offer and generates SDP Answer
• ICE candidates exchanged via Socket.io bridge
• STUN Servers resolve Public IP & NAT ports
• Zero server media load (server does not relay video)
• Screen share track substitution on active connection
• iceConnectionState monitoring with auto ICE restart
• Call end summary message posted to conversation
Node.js Express Server, Route Handlers, Controllers & Storage Engine
POST /register: Unique email / @handle checks · Bcrypt salt & hash (10 rounds) · JWT issue
POST /login: Password verification · 30-day token generation · User profile hydration
GET /me · PUT /profile · POST /update-password · Safe credential modification
POST /: Create workspace with auto-generated root general channel & unique joinCode
POST /join: Join code validator · Multi-channel node enumeration · Membership registration
POST /:id/nodes: Channel creation with custom folders (Engineering, General)
POST /:id/members & DELETE /:id/members/:userId: Admin member curation controls
GET /: Returns user's direct contacts + personal groups with nested parentGroupId tags
POST /groups: Creates root group OR nested subgroup when parentGroupId is provided
POST /: Resolves target by @username · Validates non-self contact · Reciprocal contact creation
DELETE /:id: Clean contact removal & conversation dissociation
GET /:chatId: Paginated historical message retrieval sorted chronologically
POST /:chatId: HTTP fallback message insertion with real-time Socket.io broadcast
PUT /:messageId/read & DELETE /:messageId: Read receipt status updates & message removal
POST /file & POST /avatar: Multer memoryStorage() file ingestion (25MB limit)
MongoDB Atlas Media Storage: Ingests raw Buffer & saves Media document
GET /media/:id: Binary Streaming Engine: Converts BSON to Buffer & calls res.end(rawBuffer)
Sets Content-Type: image/jpeg, preventing Express JSON corruption across devices
Local Disk Mirror: Optional fallback mirror to server /uploads directory
• createUser(): Sanitizes @username, hashes password via bcrypt, establishes initial contacts
• findUserByEmail() / findUserByUsername() / findUserById() with case-insensitive normalization
• updateUserProfile() & updateUserPassword(): Validates current credentials and updates DB
• saveMessage(): Inserts message into MongoDB Atlas Message collection with chatType enum validation
• Auto-Media Extractor: Detects base64 data:image/ URLs and extracts them to permanent Media collection
• markMessagesRead(): Updates readBy array for matching recipient and broadcasts double ticks
• createGroup(ownerId, name, desc, memberIds, avatar, parentGroupId): Stores group document
• Hierarchical Resolution: Root groups have parentGroupId: null; Subgroups reference parent group ID
• getUserConversations(): Queries Contact and PersonalGroup collections, aggregating parentGroupId
• createWorkspace(): Generates unique 6-character alphanumeric code & creates general default node
• joinWorkspaceByCode(): Atomic $addToSet of user ID to workspace members array
• addChannelNode() & removeChannelNode(): Dynamically alters workspace channel hierarchy
• blockUser() & unblockUser(): Maintains blockedUser IDs in User document schema
• addReaction(): Appends emoji reaction with user tracking to prevent duplicate reaction spam
• pingDatabase(): Monitors MongoDB connection state (readyState 1 = connected)
• Automatic retry queue for background message logging during transient network drops
MongoDB Atlas Cloud Database & Mongoose Schemas
• Multi-region replica set on AWS (Primary / Secondary)
• Mongoose 8.x ODM with TLS 1.3 encrypted wire protocol
• chatId: String (DM, Node, or Group ID)
Pool Size: 10 Candidates · Resolves symmetric NAT
Fires even when browser tab is minimized
Direct Peer-to-Peer Calling: Caller WebRTC <═ [SRTP Mesh] ═> Callee WebRTC
